info.name: M5 — Staging Manual Verification
info.description:
Manual reproduction of the M5-006 staging flow verified online 25/25 at https://api.care-systems.site.

Run folders in order 00 -> 10. ID capturing is automatic via test scripts.
No secrets are committed: tokens and passwords live only in the local uncommitted staging environment (M5_staging_local.postman_environment.json).

BODY-LESS POST FIX: endpoints like activate / resume / save take NO body. Do NOT send Content-Type: application/json with an empty body or Fastify returns FST_ERR_CTP_EMPTY_JSON_BODY -> 422. These requests intentionally send no body and no JSON content-type.
